basic_details.job_title: NIT Durgapur Internship (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Durgapur (NIT Durgapur) has 1 Internship position in an IITG TIH funded project in its Department of Mechanical Engineering, open to Indian citizens presently studying in the third or final year of B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering. The updated CV goes by email to [email protected] within 14 days from the date of publication of the advertisement (dated 2 November 2026), which works out to about 16 November 2026 (14 days from 2 November 2026). The internship carries INR 5,000/- per month for twelve months.

Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Durgapur, West Bengal
Within 14 days from the date of publication of the advertisement (about 16 November 2026 , 14 days from 2 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: About NIT Durgapur Internship
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Durgapur is located at Mahatma Gandhi Avenue, Durgapur - 713209, West Bengal. The Internship is in an IITG TIH funded project titled "Characterization and Deployment of Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) Process in Underwater Applications" in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Ratnesh Kumar, Assistant Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Durgapur.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice does not prescribe any application form; the updated CV is the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidate presently studying in B. Tech/B. E. third year and final year in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 7.5 CGPA or 70% marks from reputed Institute/Universities. The candidate must be in their 5th semester or above. The candidate must have undergone a Bachelor-Level Course on Manufacturing Engineering. The candidate must have initial exposure to either Python / C++ / MATLAB programming. Applications are invited from Indian citizens. The age limit is not specified in the notice. The selected candidate gets a Fellowship and Allowance of INR 5,000/- per month, with accommodation as per Institute Norm. The position is for a period of twelve months from the start of the internship. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.pay: INR 5,000/- per month (Accommodation as per Institute Norm)

content_sections.text: The notice asks for an updated CV containing: Corresponding address Date of birth (DOB) Phone number and email Education qualifications Experience (if any) List of publications (if any)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through shortlisting and an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed at the Institute website/email on due time. The interview date and mode are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the NIT Durgapur Internship 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) Internship position in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Durgapur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Durgapur Internship?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 14 days from the date of publication of the advertisement dated 2 November 2026, which works out to about 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the NIT Durgapur Internship?
faq.answer: Indian citizens presently studying in B. Tech/B. E. third year and final year in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 7.5 CGPA or 70% marks, in the 5th semester or above, can apply. They must have done a Bachelor-Level Course on Manufacturing Engineering and have initial exposure to Python / C++ / MATLAB programming.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for the NIT Durgapur Internship?
faq.answer: The Fellowship and Allowance is INR 5,000/- per month, with accommodation as per Institute Norm.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the NIT Durgapur Internship?
faq.answer: Send your updated CV by email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for Internship in IITG TIH project 2026".

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the NIT Durgapur Internship?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview, and the list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed at the Institute website/email on due time.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the NIT Durgapur Internship?
faq.answer: The position is for a period of twelve months from the start of the internship.

faq.question: Q8. Which project is the NIT Durgapur Internship for?
faq.answer: The Internship is in the IITG TIH funded project "Characterization and Deployment of Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) Process in Underwater Applications", with Dr. Ratnesh Kumar as Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q9. What should the CV for the NIT Durgapur Internship include?
faq.answer: The CV should include the corresponding address, DOB, phone number, email, education qualifications, experience (if any) and list of publications (if any).
